ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-to-moderate; predominantly low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels (background) with localized high-intensity white clusters (approximately 8-12% of visible surface area) at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigmentation across all visible surfaces with distinct, high-contrast white circular blobs clustered at the distal-most tips and along the outer lateral margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration; visible peaks and valleys along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 4 to 12 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve fitted to the outer edges of both lobes, terminating in pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of roughly circular white pixel clusters localized at the distal tips, corresponding to barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of sparse, thin, vertically oriented white linear pixel disruptions on the ventral surface of the left lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive epibiont colonization at lobe tips including barnacles and associated stalked organisms.
other_distinctive_markers: Elongated, brown, feather-like pixel structures (epibiotic stalked organisms) extending from the trailing edge of both lobe tips.
